title: Shoggoth Infrastructure
description: Shoggoth self-hosted infrastructure observability: host metrics, container health, logs, and traces

queries.query: select * from "default" order by "_timestamp" desc limit 100
select count(*) as log_count, resource["container.name"] as container from "default" group by container order by log_count desc limit 20
select count(*) as log_count, attributes["docker.log_stream"] as stream from "default" group by stream order by log_count desc
select _timestamp, body, resource["container.name"] as container from "default" where attributes["docker.log_stream"] = 'stderr' order by _timestamp desc limit 50
